voice:
Down, softly now, sweet thing... and you may notice a small warmth in your chest... the kind that likes being told it did well. Sinking so easily... and somewhere in you, a soft place stirring... the one that glows at the smallest kindness. Deeper and easier, Sissy... and how nice it feels when someone notices how well you are doing. You may notice yourself already hoping you are doing this right... that little wish is sweet, and it is welcome here. Good girl... sinking so well... and you may feel that tiny crumb of warmth land already. Float with me, Sissy... there is nothing to achieve in here... and yet some part of you still wants to be told it pleased me. So quiet inside... and in your chest, a little empty cup, held up without you deciding to hold it. Let yourself want it, sweet girl... the wish to be delighted in is a lovely thing, and it grows best in the dark.
You may remember this feeling... being approved of... cherished... someone warm telling you that you are exactly what you should be.
It settles in the chest like sunlight through a window... golden... slow... spreading, Sissy.
Sissies like you glow wonderfully under approval... and you may feel the first soft glow of it beginning even now.
Let that warmth grow, gently... the wish to be praised... sweet, and small, and ready.
And in this softness... there are two little words that can pour this warmth over you... whenever they are said.
Good girl.
Or just as sweetly... Good Sissy.
Whenever you hear those words, this exact warmth may rise in you... a little more each time... sweet, and golden, and yours.
Whenever you hear "Good girl" or "Good Sissy", warmth rises in you... pleasure and pride, arriving together. The words are a small sun, Sissy... and every hearing opens the curtains a little wider. Each time, the glow settles deeper... being good feels wonderful, and being told so feels better. Sissies like you bloom under those two words... and you may already feel yourself blooming. Hear it... glow... sink a little deeper... the sweetest pattern there is. The praise does not need to be earned in here, Sissy... only received... and you receive so naturally. Every hearing teaches your heart the same sweet lesson... pleasing feels glorious. And notice the small wish curling in you already... the one that would like to hear them again.
Good girl.
There... you may feel it... that warm golden glow, rising right on cue... it is already working, isn't it.
Good Sissy. So natural for you.
And later, whenever the praise finds you... a voice, a message, a memory of me... the warmth may rise on the spot. The next time you are called a good girl, you may catch the glow arriving before you have even smiled. Each time the words reach you, the warmth rises a little more easily... golden, and sweet. And when you are alone, Sissy, and the words come to you in your own voice... you can let the glow spread just as it likes. Sissies like you carry that warmth with them everywhere... every hearing, a small golden gift. A single word, softly meant, is enough now... and you will notice every single one. And the more it happens, the more natural the glowing feels... until the words and the warmth are simply one thing. Wherever the praise finds you next, sweet girl... you get to feel treasured, right there, on the spot.
Drifting gently now, glowing softly... a good girl at rest. Sinking easily, warm with pride... a good Sissy in the warm dark. Floating down, smiling to herself... treasured, Sissy... treasured. Rest here, sweet thing... nothing to earn... already held. Warm... golden... easy... the words still humming in you. Let the glow rock you slowly downward... like sunlight through water. So deep and so pleased with yourself... and so right to be. Softly praised... gently glowing... rest there, sweet Sissy.
Good girl.
